structs.notes: The 163368 IDA size and the GT 8-slot layout are not supported by Replay: every per-controller access is slot stride 1136 with the count at +1136, so there is one slot, and the shared members sit at Replay offsets chained from 1144. A124's conflict (read at 22576) is inside login[0] (22488..22584), so it does not contradict 23256. Open conflict for the coordinator: DWServicesAccess::GetInstance@0x140F6B490 returns stru_14C3851A0, the address Replay code passes as typed 'struct OnlineMgr *' in 31 places (CL_Mgr_ActivateClient etc.), and the IDA name g_onlineMgr sits 8 bytes earlier at 0x14C385198. Either DWServicesAccess is at OnlineMgr+0 in Replay (then the GT embed at OnlineMgr+1880 is wrong) or GetInstance is an accessor for another object. The OnlineMgr owner must decide; not settled here. Also the function DWServicesAccess_ctor at 0x140F6ACB0 is the constructor of the 1136-byte slot (DWWrappers), not of the whole object: it is only called from AddControllerSlot on slot addresses, and it writes the slot's lobby-service vtable at +904, the index -1 at +940 and the list head at +1120/+1128.
